items.text: Kokaru lokitomonet kaarei loka Akas ekabaka loka Yuda kogeu Kosea okoku loka Ela airum Isirael koSamaria, kirumak ikar ikanykaoŋon.
Kiswama nueroko kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT, konye mere kwape ikabakan luka Isirael luageikinete ŋes.
Kobu Salumaneser ekabaka loka Asuria asurokin ŋes; koraun Kosea ekei aanakinanike, koinununei ainakineta,

Kodum ekabaka loka Asuria ebotet kaneejai Kosea; naarai abu kijuka ikiyakia mama ejai So ekabaka loko Misiri, mam abu koinak ekabaka loka Asuria ainakinet, kwape eswamaa nolikaru: kanuka ŋun kogolok ekabaka loka Asuria ŋes, koen kaidaris.
Kosodi ekabaka loka Asuria kobu konata akwap kere, kolot Samaria, kirigau ŋes ikar iuni.
Kokaru lokikanyetekaonon loka Kosea, kirum ekabaka loka Asuria Samaria, kiioreo Isirael ayaŋaar Asuria, kibwaik kes Kala, ka Kabor, kariri kecor loka Gosan, koreria luka Imedin,
Kojai kwaŋin, naarai apotu idwe luka Isirael kodiakasi kama ejai EJAKAIT Ekecedeke, loetolomuni kes koMisiri anyoun kakan naka Parao ekabaka loko Misiri, koyonito idekesio ice.
Kolosenenete kokisila luka atekerin, nuerenei EJAKAIT kakonyen nuka idwe luka Isirael, ka nul da lukibwaikinete ikabakan luka Isirael.
Kokokoanakinos idwe luka Isirael aswam numam ejok nukasurokin EJAKAIT Ekecedeke, kodukoto aiboisio nuiceleleete koreriakee kere, ageun kotogo loeoj loka ikedarak kiton ore lokebwaitai.
Kosipokis ipirin ka Aserim kanoliukot loeoia, ido kokwap kanolikitoi loepesit.
Kisupuruununete kaŋina lueuru maa kaiboisio kere nuiceleleete, kwape eswamaenenaata atekerin nuereneari EJAKAIT kakonyenekee: kiswamata nukaronok aitunyunyurikin EJAKAIT,
Kijaanakis aputosia, nualimokinit EJAKAIT kes ebe, “Sirikiswamata akirot na.”

Konye kitejenik EJAKAIT Isirael, ka Yuda, kama ka nolinabi, ka ŋolikadwaran, ebe, “Kibelokinos yesi anyoun korotinikus lueroko, koricata aicorakinetaka ka ikakisila, kwape ejaatar ikakisila kere lukeeorakinit lukapapaakus, lukejukakinit yes kama ka ikakejaanakinak inabin.”
Konye konero akiirar, konye kitininikata imurisiijakec, kwape kimurisina luka lukapapaakec, lumam apotu kiyuut EJAKAIT Ekecedeke.

Konerenenete ikisilake, ka aitutuketeke naetutukit kalukapapaakee, ka aitejenuneta nueteienunit kes; kotupasi aamameak, koraunos lukaamameak, kotupenenete atekerin nuerimorito kes, nuabu EJAKAIT kieoro kes ebe sirikiswamata kwape kakesi.
Kojala aicorakineta kere nuka EJAKAIT Ekecedese, kosubut aputosia nuecalara, kes itak iarei, kosubut Asera da, komaenenete ajore kere nakokuiu, kijaanakis Baal,
Kitotoroenenete ikeeedwe lusap ka lupesur akim, kiswamata nuka airo ka nuka ecudet, kogwelaros aswam nueroko kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT, aitunyunyurikin ŋes.
Kanuka nun konyunyurik noi EJAKAIT Isirael, kolema kakonyeneke; mam abu kideun dimarai areker naka Yuda bon.
Yuda da mam abu koric aicorakineta nuka EJAKAIT Ekecedeke, konye kolosenenete kokisila luka Isirael Iukibwaikinete,
Koŋer EJAKAIT aur kere naka Isirael, kitican kes, kijaik kes akanin nuka ikaŋatak, aitodol nakirenearia kes kakonyeneke.
Naarai koeila Isirael alemar kotogo loka Daudi; kodakakis Yeroboam okoku loka Nebat araun ekabaka: kiŋalaa Yeroboam Isirael anyoun katupit EJAKAIT, kitidiaka kes aidiak naepol.
Kolosenenete idwe luka Isirael karonisio kere nuka Yeroboam nueswamai; mam apotu konyoutu kakesi;
Aitodol naalemaria EJAKAIT Isirael kakonyeneke, kwape enerar kama ka Ikekejaanakinak kere inabin. Koyanaarai eut Isirael Asuria anyoun kakwapuke, kiton lolo.
Koyau ekabaka loka Asuria ituŋa anyoun koBabulon, ka Kuta, ka Aba, ka Kamat, ka Separabaim, kibwaik kes oreria luka Samaria aibois naka idwe luka Isirael: kiruma Samaria kiboikinos oreriake.
Kosodi, egeete aiboi kanen, mam ayoŋito EJAKAIT: kanuka nun kijukak EJAKAIT kes iŋatunyo, luaarete ice kakesi.

Ŋes kelimokiniata ekabaka loka Asuria ebe, “Atekerin nuiyanaari ijo cut, kibwaik oreria luka Samaria, mam ejenete epone loka Edeke loka akwap: ŋes keinakini ijukakini kes iŋatunyo, ido koany, earete kes, naarai mam ejenete epone loka Edeke loka akwap.”
Kosodi ekabaka loka Asuria aicorakin atiar, “Koyanaas ediopet kosasedotin lukiyaunete kaŋina; koloto kiboioto kaŋina, kisisianak kes epone loka Edeke loka akwap.”
Kosodi ediopet kosasedotin lualemario koSamaria kobu kiboikin Bet-el, kisisianak kwape ibusakinitor ayoŋit EJAKAIT.
Konye kosubununei ŋiniteker idekesiokec, kibwaanakinete otogoi luka aiboisio nuiceleleete nuadukito Isamarian, ŋiniteker oreriakec neiboioto.
Kosubut ituŋa luka Babulon Sukot-benot, kosubut ituŋa luka Kut Nerigal, kosubut ituŋa luka Kamat Asima.
Kosubut Ibain Nibas ka Taratak, kicweenenete Iseparabin ikeeedwe kakim neejaas Adaramelek ka Anamelek, idekesio luka Separabaim.
Koyonenenete EJAKAIT, ido kotiakutu kotomakec isasedotin luka aiboisio nuiceleleete, luainanakinete asuban kanukee kotogoi luka aiboisio nuiceleleete.
Koyoŋenenete EJAKAIT, kiiaanakis da ikecedekesio, kwape kejaar epone loka atekerin nuayanaario,
lswamaete kiton lolo kwape ajaatar iponesio lukolosck.
Mam eyoŋito EJAKAIT, mam iswamaete kwape keiaar apucunetakec, karaida itubesiakec, karaida ikisila arai aicorakinet naecorakinit EJAKAIT idwe luka Yakob, loamaikinit Isirael;
Loetutuki EJAKAIT kaŋes, kicorak kes ebe, “Sirikiyoŋata icedekesio, karaida akukonokin kes, karaida aiiaanakin, karaida ainakin kes asuban:
Konye EJAKAIT, lokitolomuni yes kakwap nako Misiri. Kagogon naepol, ka akan naarioro, ŋol ŋes loiyoŋenenete, ŋol ŋes loikukonokinos, ŋol da loiinanakinete asuban;
Apucuneta ka itubesia, ka ikisila ka aicorakinet luabu ŋesi kiwadikak yes, iricenenete aswam ikar kere; sirikiyoŋa idekesio ice.
Aitutuket naetutuk eoŋ kayes, sirikimurwonokinete; karaida aiyoŋ icedekesio.
Konye koyonenenete EJAKAIT Ekusideke; kitaiarenenei ŋesi yes kakan naka lukasurupokus kere.”
Konye mam apotu kopupokis, konye kiswamata kwape ajaar eponekec lolem sek,
Koyoŋa atekerin nun EJAKAIT, kijaanakis aputosiakee nuegerer ikecedwe da, ka idwe luka ikecedwe, kwape eswamaenenaata Iukapapaakec, iswamaenenete kwaŋin kiton lolo.
